posts.title: Mid Year Update on Longevity: What's done and What's remaining?
posts.description: Last year I laid out four pillars driving the longevity boom . January started strong validating three of them . Eight months later, all four have moved forward, but they’ve hit the same wall we’re seeing across product management and tech in general : gathering the data has outpaced our ability to act on it well.
